answer: Locks are logged in delta, expire in spiral, and knoll lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 94 aliases as a result needs 96 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 642 identities would post 3520 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
